# Bundled fonts

`android/app/src/main/res/font/jtv_anek_*.ttf` are static instances of **Anek Latin** (https://github.com/EkType/Anek). They are subset to Latin plus punctuation for JTV, and are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `AnekLatin-OFL.txt`). The subset files are a modified version and keep the original licence.
